clues: This town is in the north-west of Madhya Pradesh, a state in the middle of India. It is the head town of its district.
In the monsoon season, the wet part of the year, this town draws many visitors. They come to see its many waterfalls.
Tatya Tope was a chief of the eighteen fifty-seven revolt. He was hanged in this town for his part.
Near this town lies the largest crater in all of Asia. The great hole is almost eleven kilometres wide.
This town was once the summer capital of the Scindia kings. That royal house ruled nearby Gwalior.
